csv_project_name: Design for Barnet Flood Recovery Bridge 34, 41, 44 Replace
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Barnet is requesting proposals for design and construction oversight services for the replacement of structures damaged or destroyed during the July 2024 flood events. The projects are as follows: Bridge #34 Replacement over Simpson Brook, Town Forest Road, (Lat.44.37456, Long. - 72.02517), currently temporary 10-foot diameter culvert, previously 25 L x 20 wide concrete slab deck bridge. Bridge #41 Replacement over the Stevens River, Carter St., (Lat. 44.29469, Long. - 7205071). (33 L x 23 W steel girder with concrete deck). Damaged girders and undermined north abutment. Bridge #44 Replacement over the Stevens River, Patneaude Lane (Lat. 44.30211, Long. - 72.06593). Currently temporary one lane Mabey Bridge, previously (33 L x 16 W)
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Flood Control Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering

relevance_explanation:
- Three bridge replacement projects create a meaningful bridge engineering opportunity.
- Includes explicit design services and construction oversight, which fits sbp's planning profile.
- Existing structures are relatively small spans of about 25 to 33 ft, limiting structural complexity.
- Flood recovery and hydraulic context add technical interest.
- Road bridges are relevant to sbp, but these are local short-span replacements rather than landmark or long-span structures.
